# Law Office of Cohen & Jaffe, LLP

> Long Island personal injury law firm specializing in accident representation with contingency-based legal services and free consultations.

Cohen & Jaffe is a Nassau County-based personal injury law practice founded by partners Richard S. Jaffe and Stephen M. Cohen. The firm represents accident victims across Long Island and Queens in motor vehicle, premises liability, and other injury cases on a no-fee basis.
